name: Torch
description: A wooden handle wrapped in oil-soaked cloth. Burns for 60 game-minutes once lit, providing a warm flickering light. Use LIT TORCH to ignite it.

name: Hooded Lantern
description: A sturdy iron lantern with a glass hood that shields the flame from wind. Requires Oil Flask to fuel — burns for 90 game-minutes per fill. Use LIT LANTERN to light it (consumes one Oil Flask).

name: Oil Flask
description: A small clay flask stoppered with wax, filled with lamp oil. Used to fuel a Hooded Lantern. One flask provides 90 game-minutes of lantern light.
